rationale: The stock is sitting at 93% of today's range near the session high after a sharp recovery from the $14.30 low, but the 68 bps bid-ask spread creates significant friction on a $14.70 name, making clean entries and exits costly. The last five 1-minute candles show a steady grind upward with declining momentum, and with price already extended above VWAP ($14.53) and the 9-EMA ($14.55), the risk/reward for a long is poor while there is no clear structural breakdown level to anchor a short thesis. No news catalyst and an already-committed working order in the portfolio reduce the incentive to add another position here.
